analysis: Documentation-only changes. docs/architecture/inference.md head changes (per range map: 619-625, 869-905, 1767) describe rate-observation freshness anchoring (EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate) and TTFT admission estimator corrections gated by DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES (AdmissionRateEstimators.swift, DeadlineAdmissionFixes, IsolatedPrefillAdmissionRate added to the code map at line 1767). The units shown (1235-1808) are mostly unchanged surrounding text; line 1767 is the changed code-map row. docs/developer/serving-performance-qualification.md lines 3 and 15-22 add a date bump and a statement that estimator corrections need no timing-catalog entry and keep per-row decode charge for calibrated requests. These affect availability/admission scheduling estimates only; they do not touch encryption (TB-002/T-008), attestation/authorization (TB-009/TB-011), prefix-cache scoping/TTL/HMAC (T-041/SEC-035) or media ingest bounds. Inference.md 869-905 patch text was only partially visible (patch_excerpt_complete=false); the claimed behavior (step-based decode pricing, MTP width scaling) could make admission less conservative, but deadline expiry, physical KV reservation (GlobalKVCacheBudget) and leases still apply per invariants 2-4 (lines 1701-1710). No source implementation is in this batch, so the docs' claims are unverified; no security regression identified from documentation.
